tuning_rule: STRICT (author decision 15 Nov 2026, not to be relaxed after observing results): maximise dev macro decision-accuracy over product categories P2-P7 subject to dev macro silent-error rate <= that of baseline B on dev; if no setting satisfies the constraint, report this honestly and select the setting with minimum dev macro silent-error rate; ties -> larger coverage threshold, fewer typo edits, longer min length

workloads.product: all DEV product items, each with a canonical table country (rotating)
workloads.country: all DEV country items, each with a canonical catalogue product (rotating)

statistics.ci: cluster bootstrap (resample clusters) 95% percentile + item-level Wilson
statistics.paired_test: cluster-level sign-flip permutation (two-sided) on per-cluster differences, Holm across the primary family; exact McNemar reported as item-level secondary
